text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Jun 2011.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru,

yang bermula—

(a) dari kilometer 0.00 Lebuh Raya Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru di koordinat

T9682.543, U-46983.064 Grid Cassini Negeri Johor dan berakhir di kilometer

69.50 di koordinat T71212.011, U-51148.459 Grid Cassini Negeri Johor

termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat Utama Senai, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Bandar Senai, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Senai, Persimpangan Bertingkat Ulu

Tiram, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Ulu Tiram, Persimpangan Bertingkat Cahaya

Baru, Lintasan Sungai Johor, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Penawar dan

Persimpangan Penawar dan jalan-jalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak

sepanjang 69.50 kilometer; dan

(b) dari kilometer 0.00 (PGC) Lebuh Raya Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru di koordinat

T44365.578, U-64261.849 Grid Cassini Negeri Johor dan berakhir di kilometer

7.70 (PGC) di koordinat T44871.636, U–56876.604 Grid Cassini Negeri Johor

termasuk Persimpangan Pasir Gudang, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Cahaya Baru

dan Persimpangan Bertingkat Cahaya Baru dan jalan-jalan sambungannya,

iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 7.70 kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru) 2009

[P.U (A) 328/2009] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA SENAI-PASIR GUDANG-DESARU

Dibuat 2 Jun 2011

[ [KKR.PUU.110-1/7/26; PN(PU2)391/XXIII]

]

DATO' SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat di bawah seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SENAI-PASIR GUDANG-DESARU EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Johore, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru

Expressway) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 June 2011.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru Expressway

commencing—

(a) from kilometre 0.00 of the Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru Expressway at

coordinates E9682.543, N-46983.064 of the Johore State Cassini Grid and

ending at kilometre 69.50 at coordinate E71212.011, N-51148.459 of the

Johore State Cassini Grid including the Utama Senai Interchange, Bandar

Senai Interchange, Senai Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Ulu Tiram Interchange, Ulu

Tiram Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Cahaya Baru Interchange, Sungai Johor

Crossing and Penawar Intersection and its link roads, being a distance of

69.50 kilometres; and

(b) from kilometre 0.00 (PGC) of the Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru Expressway

at coordinates E44365.578, N-64261.849 of the Johore State Cassini Grid

and ending at kilometre 7.70 (PGC) at coordinates E44871.636, N56876.604 of the Johore State Cassini Grid including the Pasir Gudang

Interchange, Cahaya Baru Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and Cahaya Baru

Interchange and its link roads, being a distance of 7.70 kilometres,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru Expressway) Order 2009

[P.U. (A) 328/2009] is revoked.
